'''Eric Witkowski Dark Side Super Control!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Eric Witkowski]]
* '''Published:''' August 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Docking Bay 94|Premiere-D-tatooinedockingbay94.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dark Side Super Control!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH Dark Side Super Control! Witkowski.txt |Download]]
